title: Setting Up a C++ Environment
description: Choosing a compiler and an editor, the four build stages, the flags you need on day one, and how to read compile errors versus linker errors.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 選擇編譯器與編輯器、建置的四個階段、第一天就會用到的編譯旗標，以及如何分辨編譯錯誤與連結錯誤。

questions.prompt: With g++, which command compiles hello.cpp into an executable named hello?

prompt.zh-Hant: 使用 g++ 時，哪一道指令會把 hello.cpp 編譯成名為 hello 的執行檔？

explanation.zh-Hant: -o 指定輸出檔名，原始檔仍留在指令列上；g++ hello 會去找一個名為 hello 的檔案，而不是編譯 hello.cpp。

questions.explanation: -o names the output file while the input source stays on the command line. g++ hello looks for a file named hello, and there is no --run option.

questions.prompt: Which command-line compiler ships with Microsoft Visual Studio?

prompt.zh-Hant: Microsoft Visual Studio 內建的命令列編譯器是哪一個？

explanation.zh-Hant: MSVC 的編譯器驅動程式是 cl.exe；cc1plus 是 GCC 內部的 C++ 前端的執行檔，ld 是連結器，nmake 是建置工具。

questions.explanation: MSVC's compiler driver is cl.exe. cc1plus is GCC's internal C++ front end, ld is a linker, and nmake is a build tool.

questions.prompt: A program can fail with a linker error even though every source file compiled without errors.

prompt.zh-Hant: 即使每個原始檔都編譯成功，程式仍可能因為連結錯誤而建置失敗。

explanation.zh-Hant: 編譯只檢查單一編譯單元；連結器之後才在各目的檔與程式庫之間解析符號，所以「已宣告但未定義」的函式會在連結階段產生未定義參考。

questions.explanation: Compiling checks each translation unit on its own. The linker later resolves symbols across object files and libraries, so a function that is declared and called but never defined fails at link time.

questions.prompt: The preprocessor checks the types of expressions before the compiler proper sees them.

prompt.zh-Hant: 前置處理器會在編譯器本體看到程式之前，先檢查運算式的型別。

explanation.zh-Hant: 前置處理器只做文字層面的工作，例如 #include、巨集展開與條件編譯；型別檢查是之後由編譯器本體負責。

questions.explanation: The preprocessor only performs textual work such as #include, macro expansion and conditional compilation. Type checking happens later, inside the compiler proper.

questions.prompt: Which of these are C++ compilers? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 編譯器？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: g++、clang++、cl.exe 都是編譯器；make 是建置自動化工具，負責呼叫編譯器，本身不會編譯程式碼。

questions.explanation: g++, clang++ and cl.exe are compilers. make is a build automation tool that invokes a compiler; it does not compile code itself.

questions.prompt: Which statements about header files are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於標頭檔的敘述，哪些正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 標頭檔通常存放供多個 .cpp 共用的宣告。

b.zh-Hant: #include "my.h" 會把 my.h 的內容插入到該處的編譯單元中。

c.zh-Hant: 每個標頭檔都會被單獨編譯成一個執行檔。

d.zh-Hant: #pragma once 可避免同一個標頭檔在同一個編譯單元中被重複引入。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標頭檔是給 #include 展開用的，不會單獨產生執行檔；#pragma once（或傳統的 include guard）可防止同一編譯單元重複引入。

options.text: A header usually contains declarations shared by several .cpp files.
#include "my.h" inserts the contents of my.h at that point in the translation unit.
Each header is compiled into its own separate executable.
#pragma once stops a header from being included more than once in the same translation unit.

questions.explanation: Headers are expanded by #include and never become executables on their own. #pragma once, or a conventional include guard, prevents repeated inclusion in one translation unit.

questions.prompt: Which diagnostic typically comes from the linker rather than from the compiler?

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪一種診斷訊息通常來自連結器，而不是編譯器？

c.zh-Hant: 'cout' was not declared in this scope

explanation.zh-Hant: 「undefined reference」表示符號有宣告卻找不到定義，是連結階段的問題；其餘三項都是編譯器在單一編譯單元內就能發現的語法或型別錯誤。

options.text: 'cout' was not declared in this scope

questions.explanation: An undefined reference means a symbol was declared and used but no definition was found, which is a link-time problem. The other three are syntax or type errors the compiler detects within one translation unit.

questions.prompt: What does passing -Wall to g++ or clang++ do?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 g++ 或 clang++ 加上 -Wall 會有甚麼效果？

a.zh-Hant: 開啟一大組常用的警告，但不包含編譯器所知的全部警告。

b.zh-Hant: 把所有警告都變成錯誤。

c.zh-Hant: 靜態連結 C++ 標準程式庫。

d.zh-Hant: 開啟絕對全部的警告，包括非常吵雜的那些。

explanation.zh-Hant: -Wall 是一組精選的常用警告，不代表全部；-Wextra 會再加一些，-Werror 才把警告當成錯誤，靜態連結則是 -static。

options.text: It enables a broad set of common warnings, though not every warning the compiler knows.
It turns every warning into an error.
It statically links the C++ standard library.
It enables absolutely all warnings, including very noisy ones.

questions.explanation: -Wall is a curated group of common warnings, not all of them. -Wextra adds more, -Werror turns warnings into errors, and -static requests static linking.

questions.prompt: To build with the C++17 language standard, pass the flag ____ to g++ or clang++.

prompt.zh-Hant: 若要使用 C++17 語言標準建置，要傳給 g++ 或 clang++ 的旗標是 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: -std=c++17 會選用 C++17 語言標準；其他版本寫法如 -std=c++14、-std=c++20，若省略則由編譯器版本決定預設標準。

questions.explanation: -std=c++17 selects the C++17 language standard. Sibling flags such as -std=c++14 and -std=c++20 work the same way, and without one the compiler uses its default standard.

questions.prompt: Explain the difference between a compile error and a linker error, and give one typical cause of each.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明編譯錯誤與連結錯誤的差別，並各舉一個典型成因。

model.zh-Hant: 編譯錯誤表示某個編譯單元違反語言規則，例如漏了分號或型別不符，編譯器會指出檔案與行號；連結錯誤則表示各檔案都編譯成功，但連結器無法解析符號或找到程式庫，例如函式已宣告且被呼叫卻沒有定義。

explanation.zh-Hant: 分辨方法是看建置停在哪一步：編譯階段看得到原始碼位置，連結階段只看到符號名稱，例如 C++ 的名稱修飾結果。

answer.model: A compile error means one translation unit violates the language rules, for example a missing semicolon or a type mismatch, and the compiler reports a file and line. A linker error means the individual files compiled but the linker cannot resolve a symbol or find a library, for example a function that is declared and called but never defined.

questions.explanation: A useful check is which stage stopped: compiler diagnostics point at source locations, while linker diagnostics name symbols, often in mangled form.
